```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE, warning= FALSE, results = 'hide'}
library(kableExtra)
library(DT)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(downloadthis)
Sample_Name <- params$SampleName
Name <- params$AuthorName
```


<hr style="border: 1px solid white; width: 100%; margin:0px; padding:0px;" />
  `r Sys.Date()` ---
**`r Name`** ---
**`r Sample_Name`**  
<hr style="border: 1px solid white; width: 100%; margin:0px; padding:0px;" />
<p> </p>




```{r, include=FALSE,echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
#read in our table of distinct transcripts and the table of distinct hits 
Table10 <- read.csv(params$Table10)
Table11 <- read.csv(params$Table11)


```

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
Table10 %>% 
  download_this(
    output_name = paste0(Sys.Date(), "_Table10.SignalP.Top 100 distinct transcripts with Hits by Bitscore_", Name),
    output_extension = ".csv",
    button_label = "Download distinct transcript as csv",
    button_type = "primary",
    csv2 = FALSE,
  )
```


```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
Table11 %>% 
  download_this(
    output_name = paste0(Sys.Date(), "_Table11.SignalP.Top 100 distinct Hits by Bitscore_", Name),
    output_extension = ".csv",
    button_label = "Download distinct hits as csv",
    button_type = "primary",
    csv2 = FALSE,
  )
```


# Top 100 Sorted by Bit Score, Distinct Transcripts

```{r,echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
#display table of distinct transcripts 
Table10 %>%
  kable("html", 
        booktabs = TRUE, 
        escape = FALSE) %>%  
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("hover", "condensed", "responsive", "bordered"),fixed_thead = TRUE, 
                full_width = TRUE, 
                position = "center") %>% 
  column_spec(1, width = "4cm", bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "#0a4136") %>% 
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, font_size = 14, color = "white", background = "#0a4136") 

```

# Top 100 Sorted by Bit Score, Distinct Hits
```{r,echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
#display table of distinct hits
Table11 %>%
  kable("html", 
        booktabs = TRUE, 
        escape = FALSE) %>%  
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("hover", "condensed", "responsive", "bordered"),fixed_thead = TRUE, 
                full_width = TRUE, 
                position = "center") %>% 
  column_spec(1, width = "4cm", bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "#0a4136") %>% 
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, font_size = 14, color = "white", background = "#0a4136") 


```
